claim: Cards are structural furniture — main title, chapter, location, time, end — and should never cost you a hand-built shot. Declaring one lets the edit drop it at the boundary with the right hold length and the right music sting attached.
not_visual: Every option is a text graphic composited in ffmpeg over or between shots, so the subject panel is identical for all six. SDXL also renders legible text unreliably, meaning a render would document the model's spelling failures rather than the variable.
